migrationNotes: First release of Campaign 2 Case 02, runtime case missing_dance, the Ares Botanical Garden in Olympia District, Mars.

Registered between Case 01 and Case 03. Every case keeps its runtime case number and none was renumbered; only Case 03's registry displayOrder moved from 9 to 10 so the Case menu lists all three in case-number order.
